messages:
Priya: heads-up — I need to swap primary for the 22:00->06:00 overnight window (UTC) on Thu. travel conflict. can someone cover primary for me 00:00-04:00 UTC specifically? I can keep 22:00-00:00 and 04:00-06:00.

rotation-bot: @Priya noted. suggested swap: Priya -> Sam for 00:00-04:00 UTC. confirm with recipient. (runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-rotation) :wave:

Sam: I can take primary 00:00-04:00 UTC. quick Q — is there any planned deploy or maintenance during that window?

Priya: no planned deploys. there is a small infra job at 02:30 that usually spikes DB connections for ~3m, see runbook link for mitigation steps. not blocking though.

Javier: fyi there is a possible coverage gap at 03:30-04:00 UTC because secondary is listed as Maya but she's got a meeting at 03:45->04:30. maybe we should flip secondary for that hour.

Maya: correct, I have a finance sync at 03:45 that I can't shift. I can be secondary 00:00-03:40 or 04:30-06:00. happy to be main earlier or later.

Sam: ok — proposal: Sam primary 00:00-04:00, secondary Javier 00:00-03:40, Maya takes 04:30-06:00. but we need someone secondary for 03:40-04:30. any volunteers for that 50m?

Priya: I can extend to 04:15 to cover 03:40-04:15 if needed, then hand back to Sam remotely. but I'd prefer not to be on-call while packing. :sweat_smile:

Maya: if Priya can cover to 04:15 I'll take 04:15-06:00 secondary. that leaves 04:15-04:30 still uncovered.

Javier: I can cover 03:40-04:00. that leaves 04:00-04:30 — I can extend to 04:30 if needed, but will need to be paged via SMS if I miss slack.

rotation-bot: swap updated: primary for 00:00-04:00 UTC -> Sam (accepted). secondaries: 00:00-03:40 -> Javier, 03:40-04:30 -> Javier (extended), 04:30-06:00 -> Maya. escalation channels: pager/sms/email set per user profile. Change recorded: https://redwood.internal/rotations/2003456789

IncidentBot: Alert summary (previous 12h): increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate at 21:48 UTC, spike resolved after autoscaler cooldown. No customer SLA breaches. Recommend on-call to watch latency and tails during your window.

Sam: thanks for the heads-up. I'll monitor the generation cluster during the 00:00-04:00 window and have the DB connection mitigations at hand.

Priya: copying the runbook snippet for quick access — step order for DB spike mitigation:
```
1) Scale read-replicas: infra scale-replicas --service gen-db --count +2
2) Temporarily throttle inference batch size: set-config inference.batch_max_seq=256
3) If errors persist, failover to standby cluster (see runbook link)
```

Sam: noted. also adding a quick checklist to the thread: 
- primary: Sam (00:00-04:00)
- secondary: Javier (00:00-04:30)
- overflow/late secondary: Maya (04:30-06:00)
- Priya covers 22:00-00:00 and 04:15-06:00 partial as discussed
- runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-503
- pager escalation: level1 -> Sam -> Javier -> Eng-SRE oncall

Javier: can we add a note to ping me on SMS for any pages 03:30-04:30? I'll set my phone to Do Not Disturb exceptions.

rotation-bot: reminder scheduled: 30m before swap (23:30 UTC) to Priya and Sam; 5m before swap (23:55 UTC) to Sam and Javier.

Maya: all sounds good. I'll update my calendar and adjust meeting invite. :thumbsup:

Sam: thanks everyone. I'll post a short handoff message right before 00:00 with live context. if anything changes ping here or DM.

Priya: thank you — appreciate the cover. leaving this thread open for any last-minute bumps. :heart:
